findings.title: Deleted river is silently restored by last-region checkpoint without destructive preview
steps: Create a valid river in region1.
Generate a neighboring region, so its checkpoint contains this river.
Delete river with explicit confirmation; river list is empty.
Set confirmation handler to reject and invoke deleteLastRegion.
findings.expected: Preview states river deletion will be replaced/restored; rejecting confirmation leaves map/history untouched.
findings.cause: confirmRiverCheckpointLoss iterates current rivers only. The deleted river has no current row, hence its restoration is never counted.
findings.scope: Checkpoint restoration remains allowed after explicit preview; no permanent manual lock requested.
